presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: Fictional facts: Party A's promise token (pay 300 for the repainted fence) and Party B's performance token (repaint the fence) cross between the parties and are linked as supplied; the performance is identified as supplied; the concept label "consideration" is shown as supplied and illustrative.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: other parties and facts (a monthly garden fee and the garden's maintenance), the performance token sent first, and the supplied status "question to be analysed": the link and a ring round the performance token use the dashed pending marker — an open question, not a failure.

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long names, captions, references, texts and time labels, three terms, two annotations; the two receipts are supplied with one position (order to be examined) and the hold shows the supplied status; a long concept label. Standing coordinator rule item 20 (caps with the true reason). The pre-cap values are kept in LAW-0461.presets.precap.json. Each capped field was restored alone to its pre-cap value on top of the shipped preset and rendered (layout verdict per ratio): the promise reference 13 -> 21, the second term label 12 -> 15 and value 16 -> 30, the third term value 18 -> 39 and the performance reference 13 -> 25 each make 1:1 fail (nofit: the cards grow too tall for the racks and the hands cannot reach); the promise title 31 -> 66 makes 9:16 and 1:1 fail (nofit); the first term value 21 -> 34 makes 9:16 fail (the strip no longer fits under the racks); the two grouped receipt time labels 26 -> 40 make 9:16 fail (nofit) and leave 1:1 without a place for the two notes. With every capped field restored, all three ratios fail. Every capped value stays longer than its baseline counterpart (references 13 vs 5, title 31 vs 21, first term value 21 vs 15, second term label 12 vs 3 and value 16 vs 9, receipt time labels 26 vs 24; the third term has no baseline counterpart); every count is kept or larger (three terms, five events, two annotations). Shipped: 16.1 px text in each ratio; heads 84.7 px (16:9), 76.7 px (9:16), 60.3 px (1:1) (rendered).
